items.question: How many years is the validity of a UAE passport issued to citizens aged 21 years and above?
items.gold: 10 years from the date of issuance, or until all its pages are fully used, whichever happens earlier.
items.fact: Adult UAE passport valid 10 years from issuance

items.question: How many months before its expiry date can a UAE passport be renewed?
items.gold: Six months before its expiry date.
items.fact: UAE passport renewable six months before expiry date
